svg.aria-label: Shieldify Security: Web3/Web2 Security Company. Hybrid Web3 and Web2 security, approved partner in the Ava Labs Audit Program, fluent in Solidity, Rust, Go, Move, ZK and off-chain code. Unlimited audits, 6-layered approach, 170+ security reviews. Threats are caught at each of the six layers. Trusted by Lido, Multipli, Pear, Colb Finance, Harmonix, Dinero, Ambire, Etherspot, Yield Fields, Up, Aborean and more.
